item.title: Logicstics: International Moving Sales
item.description:
Headquarters: Philadelphia, PA, USA
URL: https://logicstics.com

Job Title: International Moving Sales Representative

Location: Remote

Job Type: Full-time, Monday through Friday 9am to 6pm EST.

Responsibilities: As an International Moving Sales Representative at Logicstics, you will play a crucial role in expanding our client base and driving revenue growth. Your primary responsibilities will include:

1. Automated Warm Lead Engagement: Utilize our automated system to engage with potential clients who have expressed interest in our international moving services.

2. Consultative Selling: Understand clients' relocation needs and provide tailored solutions. Conduct consultations to assess requirements and offer comprehensive moving packages.

3. Quoting and Pricing: Prepare accurate and competitive quotes based on clients' specifications. Clearly communicate pricing structures and negotiate terms to secure business.

4. Relationship Building: Cultivate strong relationships with clients, addressing inquiries promptly, and maintaining regular communication throughout the moving process.

5. Market Research: Stay informed about industry trends, competitor activities, and market demands. Provide insights to enhance service offerings.

6. Collaboration: Work closely with the operations team to ensure the smooth execution of moving services. Coordinate with other departments to meet client expectations.

Qualifications:

  • Proven experience in sales. international moving experience is a plus.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Results-driven with a focus on meeting and exceeding sales targets.
  • Computer proficiency is a must.
  • Familiarity with CRM software and sales tools.
  • Understanding of the international relocation industry, including customs regulations and documentation is a plus.

Experience:

  • At least 5 years of relevant sales experience is required.
  • Bilingual a plus

Training:

  • Paid training will be provided to ensure you have the skills and knowledge needed to excel in your role.

How to Apply: Interested candidates are encouraged to submit their resume along with a brief cover letter highlighting their relevant experience. We are currently accepting applications and review each one carefully.

Please Note: Qualified applicants can expect to hear from us within approximately two weeks of submitting their application.

Join Logicstics and be a part of delivering exceptional international moving experiences. 

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/logicstics-international-moving-sales

item.title: Kuno Creative Group, Inc.: Senior Revenue Operations Strategist
item.description:
Headquarters: Cleveland, Ohio, United States
URL: http://kunocreative.com

About

Join Kuno Creative, a leading employee-owned branding, marketing, and sales agency and a Diamond HubSpot partner. We specialize in guiding companies we believe in toward growth and success through innovative digital solutions. We help companies build predictable pipelines that show clear ROI and forecastable revenue. Our employee-focused mission fosters collaboration, innovation, and measurable client success.

Summary

The Senior Revenue Operations Strategist is an experienced individual-contributor role responsible for independently leading Kuno's most complex, enterprise-scale HubSpot engagements, from platform strategy and hands-on implementation through ongoing optimization, while managing a dedicated book of client accounts. This role adds critical technical and strategic depth, working alongside RevOps Leadership as Kuno scales its portfolio of HubSpot Enterprise clients. The Senior Strategist combines deep platform expertise, integration know-how, and consultative strategy skills to design scalable systems, elevate the broader RevOps team's technical capabilities, and build the delivery capacity Kuno needs to take on larger, more complex client engagements. This role is reserved for practitioners who consistently demonstrate expertise leading enterprise-scale client engagements with minimal oversight while serving as a technical resource to the broader Revenue Operations team.

If you love the moment a client's tech stack finally clicks into place, this role is for you. You'll own the discovery process for our largest HubSpot clients, learn how their sales, marketing, and service teams actually work, and then build the systems that bring it all together. You'll guide engagements from that first "how does everything connect" conversation through implementation and ongoing optimization. This role is built for someone who's spent years working deeply in HubSpot, is comfortable across every Hub, and can step into a messy integration and know exactly where to start.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Enterprise Account Ownership & Delivery: Lead discovery, implementation planning, and technical delivery for Kuno's HubSpot Enterprise engagements, including integrations with third-party systems (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Dialpad, CallRail). Serve as the senior escalation point, own delivery end-to-end, and quality-check deliverables for these accounts.
  • Strategic & GTM Advisory: Act as a senior strategic advisor to clients' marketing, sales, and customer success leadership, tailoring RevOps strategy, workflows, and buyer journeys to each client's B2B business model and platform roadmap.
  • AI & Advanced Analytics: Design AI-powered workflows, agents, and automations within HubSpot (e.g., Breeze Intelligence), and leverage custom reporting to deliver predictive modeling, forecasting, and advanced insights for clients.
  • Process, Playbook & Documentation: Develop repeatable frameworks, SOPs, and playbooks, and produce clear, thorough documentation for all client configurations, integrations, and processes, reducing dependency on any single person and building organizational capacity to scale.

Occasional Responsibilities

  • Pre-Sales & Scoping Support: As needed, partner with business development and account leadership to scope, solution, and estimate enterprise engagements, ensuring proposals reflect realistic delivery capacity and technical feasibility.
  • Mentorship & Team Enablement: As needed, provide coaching, technical guidance and peer mentorship to Consultants and Specialists in advanced HubSpot configuration, integrations, and RevOps strategy; contribute to team-wide training through collaboration, office hours and knowledge sharing to raise technical capability across the department.
  • Continuous Learning: Stay current on HubSpot Enterprise features, share emerging RevOps technologies and industry best practices, and maintain relevant certifications with the broader RevOps team.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Marketing/Sales Operations, or a related discipline, including experience managing enterprise-scale accounts
  • Deep, hands-on expertise across the HubSpot ecosystem (Marketing Hub, Sales Hub, Service Hub, Operations Hub) at the Enterprise tier, with current HubSpot certifications
  • Experience with call/dialer applications (e.g., Dialpad, CallRail, Aircall) and ERP system integrations (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics), including ongoing administration and optimization
  • Solid understanding of system architecture principles, with the ability to execute integrations and configurations across platforms (e.g., Salesforce, ERPs, call/dialer tools, custom applications)
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring team members and elevating technical capability across a team, without formal people-management responsibility
  • Strong analytical skills, with experience turning complex data into actionable insight for enterprise stakeholders
  • Outstanding communication skills and executive presence, with experience engaging senior client stakeholders
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent work experience

Skills and Competencies

  • Deep subject-matter expertise in RevOps strategy, systems implementation, and HubSpot Enterprise capabilities
  • Ability to operate as a strategic advisor while remaining hands-on with technical delivery, managing an independent book of client accounts
  • Strong documentation skills; able to translate complex technical configurations, integrations, and processes into clear, client-facing materials
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and driving clarity on high-complexity engagements
  • Familiarity with tools such as Salesforce, call/dialer platforms (e.g., Dialpad, CallRail), ERP systems, Basecamp, Zoom, Slack, and Google Workspace
  • Current HubSpot certifications required (e.g., Revenue Operations, CRM Implementation, Solutions Architecture)
  • Hands-on experience building AI-powered workflows and applications in RevOps (predictive lead scoring, churn prediction, forecasting, HubSpot Breeze Intelligence).

Training

Kuno uses HubSpot for most clients, and this role is built for someone who already brings hands-on HubSpot experience and current certifications. To support continued growth, you'll have ongoing access to HubSpot Academy courses and emerging platform training, including new feature releases, AI tools, and advanced certifications, to keep your expertise sharp and aligned with the latest capabilities. Existing certifications should be renewed periodically as the platform evolves.

Work Environment

Remote-first work environment that fosters collaboration, creativity, and work-life balance, enabling our team members to thrive from anywhere. With the support of modern tools and a strong virtual community, we ensure all employees have the resources they need to succeed while staying connected and engaged.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to sit for extended periods during the workday
  • Ability to travel to off-site locations for events, meetings, or client engagements, with the ability to bend, kneel, lift, and reach up to 20lbs, with or without accommodation
  • Ability to use standard office equipment, including a computer, keyboard, mouse, and phone
  • Ability to read printed and digital materials, including reports, emails, and training materials
  • Ability to hear and respond effectively during in-person or virtual meetings and phone conversations

Benefits

  • 100% remote, flexible work environment.  
  • Employee-owned company with annual profit-sharing.
  • Generous benefits: healthcare, 401(k) with match, paid maternity and parental leave.
  • Unlimited PTO.

Job Specifications

  • Department: Revenue Operations
  • Reports to: Revenue Operations Delivery Manager
  • Location: Remote *This is a 100% remote position and is open to anyone authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship who is residing in the United States.
  • Travel: ~10-15%
  • Job Type: Full-time
  • Status: Exempt
  • Direct Reports: No

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/kuno-creative-group-inc-senior-revenue-operations-strategist

item.title: Performancepixel GmbH: Art Director Performance Creatives (m/w/d)
item.description:
Headquarters: Germany Cologne

Performancepixel ist eine Performance Design Agentur im DACH Raum. Wir entwickeln datengetriebene Ad Creatives, Creative Strategien und skalierbare Produktionsprozesse für Social Ads, vor allem auf Meta und TikTok.

Wir suchen einen Art Director, der zwei Sachen mitbringt: ein richtig starkes kreatives Auge und die Fähigkeit, Zahlen zu lesen. Du entwickelst nicht einfach schöne Designs, du entwickelst Creative Strategien, die auf Daten basieren. Der Kunde schickt eine Kampagne, du gehst in die Tiefe und baust die Strategie dahinter. Und du leitest unser Creative Team an, damit aus der Strategie skalierbare Ads werden.

Wichtig vorab: Wir arbeiten nicht mit Adobe. Unser Setup basiert auf Claude, Figma und Higgsfield. Wenn du Bock hast, mit einem der modernsten AI Workflows im Creative Bereich zu arbeiten, bist du hier richtig.

Aufgaben

  • Creative Strategien entwickeln: Der Kunde schickt eine Kampagne, du arbeitest die Strategie dahinter aus, mit einem großen Research Anteil
  • Wettbewerbsresearch: Welche Ads schalten die Wettbewerber, wie sind die aufgebaut, welche Arten von Ads funktionieren aktuell auf den Plattformen
  • Creative Deconstruction: Ads systematisch zerlegen und verstehen, welche Hooks funktionieren, was Aufmerksamkeit erzeugt und wie man die Zielgruppe bestmöglich abholt
  • Performance Analyse im Ads Manager: Welche Ads laufen gut, welche nicht, Learnings ableiten und daraus neue Strategien und Testing Ansätze entwickeln
  • Kampagnenkonzepte, Testing Strategien und Messaging Ansätze für unsere Kunden erarbeiten
  • Anleitung und Weiterentwicklung des Creative Teams (Grafikdesigner, Motion Designer, Video Editoren, Copywriter)
  • Qualitätssicherung aller Werbemittel, visuell und performance-seitig, inklusive Safe Zones und plattformgerechter Umsetzung
  • Creative Reportings und Strategy Präsentationen für Kunden erstellen und präsentieren
  • Deinen eigenen Workflow mit AI Tools ständig weiterentwickeln und Learnings ins Team tragen

Qualifikation

  • 3+ Jahre Erfahrung in Art Direction, Creative Strategy oder Creative Lead Rollen im Performance Marketing oder Agenturumfeld
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Ad Creative Konzepten für Meta, TikTok o.ä. (PFLICHT, bitte im Portfolio zeigen)
  • Du kannst mit Zahlen arbeiten: Ads Manager Daten lesen, CTR, Hook Rate, ROAS interpretieren und daraus Strategien ableiten
  • Du verstehst, wie der Algorithmus arbeitet, wie Ads aktuell funktionieren und worin sich die Plattformen unterscheiden
  • Du bist hochkreativ und entwickelst unike Ideen, keine Copy Paste Ads
  • AI Skills: Du bist mit Tools wie Claude, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs und Co vertraut und hast Bock, deinen Workflow ständig zu verbessern (unser Fokus liegt auf Claude, Figma und Higgsfield)
  • Führungserfahrung: Du hast bereits ein kreatives Team angeleitet
  • Fähigkeit, kreative Ideen klar und überzeugend vor Kunden zu präsentieren
  • Du beschäftigst dich auch privat mit Social Ads, Trends und Plattform Updates
  • Sprache: Deutsch mind. C1, Englisch mind. B2

Benefits

  • Arbeite mit einem der modernsten AI Creative Workflows der Branche (Claude, Figma, Higgsfield)
  • Arbeite mit Marken, die Creative ernst nehmen (u.a. MyMüsli, Olavson, Elotrans etc.)
  • Remote-first, flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Datengetriebenes Umfeld, jede kreative Entscheidung wird messbar
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung
  • Urban Sports Mitgliedschaft
  • JobRad
  • Mehrere Workations pro Jahr
  • Regelmäßige Team Events
  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Du formst die kreative Ausrichtung der Agentur mit

Unser Prozess:

  1. Bewerbung einreichen (CV + Portfolio/Case Studies)
  2. Kennenlerngespräch mit Gerrit (GF)
  3. Strategy Case (bezahlt)
  4. Finales Gespräch + Rahmenbedingungen

Zusätzliche Infos:

  • Arbeitsplatz: Remote oder Hybrid (Deutschland)
  • Art der Beschäftigung: Vollzeit / Freelance
  • Jobkategorie: Design und Architektur → Grafik- und Kommunikationsdesign
  • Karrierestufe: Senior / Lead
  • Fähigkeiten: Art Direction, Creative Strategy, Performance Marketing, Meta Ads, Creative Analytics, AI Tools, Team Leadership

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/performancepixel-gmbh-art-director-performance-creatives-m-w-d
